source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Salt Hydrolysis, printed as a second topic 9.8 on page 204.

blocks.text: Jab koi salt pani mein halta hai to woh apne ions mein toot (dissociate) jata hai. Yeh ions pani se react kar sakte hain, aur is se solution ka pH badal sakta hai. pH ka badalna is baat par munhasir hai ke salt kis qism ke acid aur base se bana hai. Agle chaar topics mein chaar soorten hain.

blocks.title: Salt hydrolysis
blocks.text: Hal shuda salt ke ions ka pani se react karna salt hydrolysis kehlata hai. Is se solution acid aur base ki taqat ke mutabiq acidic, basic ya neutral ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Kuch salts pani mein halne par pH kyun badalte hain jabke kuch nahi?
blocks.explanation: Ion pH tabhi badalta hai jab woh pani se react kare. Weak acid ka conjugate base pani se proton le kar OH⁻ chhorta hai, aur weak base ka conjugate acid pani ko proton de kar H₃O⁺ banata hai. Strong acids aur strong bases ke conjugates itne kamzor hain ke pani se react nahi karte, is liye solution neutral rehta hai.

items: Salt ke ions pani se react (hydrolyse) kar ke pH badal sakte hain; nateeja is par munhasir hai ke asal acid aur base strong the ya weak.
